Team.metaTitle: Our Team | Blue Bird Pictures Studio Creators & Developers
Team.metaDescription: Meet the visionaries behind Blue Bird Pictures Studio, led by Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong and an international team of engineers.
Team.headerDesc: Behind <highlight>Blue Bird Pictures Studio</highlight> is a dedicated group building the best tools to make your editing and asset management easier than ever.
Team.quote:
We don't just write code; we are building a bridge
that merges <highlight>Art and Technology</highlight> into one.
Team.phil1Desc: Every line of code and system detail is engineered for maximum accuracy and stability for professionals.
Team.phil2Desc: We constantly push boundaries to create cutting-edge tools that answer the future of media production.
Team.phil3Desc: Performance is key. Our software must run fast, seamless, and never interrupt your creative flow.
Team.ctaDesc: "At <strong_highlight>Blue Bird Pictures Studio</strong_highlight> we never stop researching and developing new technologies to provide the best experiences and tools for <italic_highlight>creators worldwide</italic_highlight>. Because we believe that <color_highlight>great ideas deserve the best tools</color_highlight>."
Team.member1Name2: (กฤศกร รัตนปทุมพงส์)
Team.member1Role: Founder, Film Producer & Lead Architect (Blue Bird Composer Pro)
Team.member1Bio: A leading executive and founder with core roles as a 'Film Producer' and 'Sound Engineer'. He seamlessly blends limitless technical skills (engineering, computer science, audio systems, VFX) with perfect creativity. Currently the key spearhead as the 'Lead Architect of Blue Bird Composer Pro' under Blue Bird Pictures Studio, he is the mastermind behind the state-of-the-art system architecture. With extensive experience collaborating on national projects and top brands such as GDH, BOXX MUSIC, YUPP, Osotspa, and Singha Corporation, he also serves as a committee member and producer for the Online Mass Media Association, reinforcing his relentless leadership in driving both the film and technology industries forward.
Team.member2Name2: (ไวแอตต์ มิตเชลล์)
Team.member2Bio: A highly skilled software developer and co-founder of Blue Bird Pictures Studio. He is the driving force behind programming and developing the core systems of the Blue Bird Composer Pro plugin, working directly from his base in California, USA. With deep expertise in coding and software architecture, Wyatt is the mastermind who transforms cutting-edge ideas into powerful, practical software. He is passionate about creating new technologies and is dedicated to elevating the standards of audio and film production to the next level.
Team.member3Name2: (เร็น ทานากะ 蓮 田中)
Team.member3Bio: An exceptional software developer straight from Tokyo, Japan. Another key 'Co-Developer' behind the success of the Blue Bird Composer Pro plugin. With his expertise and Japanese-style meticulousness in programming, Ren flawlessly blends technological vision with complex problem-solving. He is a driving force pushing every line of code to achieve maximum performance and stability, making the program truly capable of meeting the demands of professional use.

Founder.metaTitle: Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong | Film Director & Studio Founder
Founder.metaDescription: Biography of Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong: Film Director of 4 Elemental Guardians, Sound Engineer, and Founder of Blue Bird Pictures Studio.
Founder.imageAlt: Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong (กฤศกร รัตนปทุมพงส์) Film Director, Film Producer and Founder of Blue Bird Pictures Studio
Founder.h1: Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong (กฤศกร รัตนปทุมพงส์)
Founder.subtitle: Founder, Film Director, Producer & Lead Architect (Blue Bird Composer Pro)
Founder.paragraph1: Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong (กฤศกร รัตนปทุมพงส์) is the executive and founder of Blue Bird Pictures Studio, serving primarily as a Film Director, Film Producer, Sound Engineer, and Lead Software Architect behind the professional plugin Blue Bird Composer Pro. With expertise that seamlessly bridges cinematic art, audio engineering, and computer science, he has collaborated on major national projects and top brands including GDH, BOXX MUSIC, YUPP, Osotspa, and Singha Corporation, directed the documentary film "4 Jaturathep: Dao Prajam Mueang" (4 จตุรเทพ ดาวประจำเมือง), and serves as a Committee Member and Producer for the Online Mass Media Association.

Founder.role2Desc: Lead Software Architect and creator of Blue Bird Composer Pro

Founder.h2Education: Education & Musical Foundation (ประวัติการศึกษาและรากฐานทางดนตรี)
Founder.educationIntro: The multifaceted expertise of Kritsakorn Rattanapathumphong was forged through musical mastery as a Western classical and marching band musician from early childhood (Kindergarten 1 to Grade 9), pursued in parallel with information technology education starting in vocational studies, before achieving academic excellence by earning two Bachelor's degrees from Siam University—both with First-Class Honors (เกียรตินิยมอันดับ 1)—forming a vital cornerstone seamlessly uniting cinematic art, sound engineering, and computer science.
Founder.edu1: Bachelor of Communication Arts (First-Class Honors) in Film, Television, and Digital Media — Siam University (นิเทศศาสตรบัณฑิต เกียรตินิยมอันดับ 1 สาขาวิชาภาพยนตร์ โทรทัศน์ และสื่อดิจิทัล มหาวิทยาลัยสยาม)
Founder.edu2: Bachelor of Science (First-Class Honors) in Computer Science — Siam University (วิทยาศาสตรบัณฑิต เกียรตินิยมอันดับ 1 สาขาวิชาวิทยาการคอมพิวเตอร์ มหาวิทยาลัยสยาม)
Founder.edu3: Graduated with a Vocational Certificate in Business Computer from Siam Technology College (สำเร็จการศึกษาระดับประกาศนียบัตรวิชาชีพ สาขาวิชาคอมพิวเตอร์ธุรกิจ วิทยาลัยเทคโนโลยีสยาม - สยามเทค)
Founder.edu4: Studied Grades 7 through 9 (ม.1–ม.3) at Wat Rai Khing Wittaya School, continuously performing as a Western classical musician in the school marching band
Founder.edu5: Studied Grades 3 through 6 (ป.3–ป.6) at Wat Rai Khing (Sunthorn Uthit) School, alongside rigorous classical marching band training
Founder.edu6: Studied Kindergarten 1 through Grade 2 (อ.1–ป.2) at Nakprasith School, serving as the foundational stepping stone of his journey as a marching band musician
